lines.en: label tsubasaspring4:
scene noonsky
I hesitantly tap on Tsubasa’s name in my phone...knowing that, if she answers, I’ll have a hard time coming out of the conversation unscathed.
lines.zh: 我犹豫着点开手机里 Tsubasa 的名字……心里清楚,只要她接起,这场通话我很难全身而退。

lines.en: Because she’s talked to me before about what’s typically done with girls in rich families — how they’re traded like cattle.
lines.zh: 因为她以前和我说过,富家的女孩通常会有什么下场——如何像牲口一样被交易。

lines.en: I’ve just never expected it would happen to the ones that I know. Let alone the ones she’s raised.
lines.zh: 我只是从没想过,这会落到我认识的人头上。更别提她亲手养大的。

lines.en: And as always, I just can’t understand why she’d do this.
lines.zh: 而且一如既往,我就是无法理解她为什么要这么做。

lines.en: : Hello? Akira?
lines.zh: : 喂?Akira?

lines.en: If she even is doing it at all and Chinami wasn’t just...dramatically misunderstanding something.
lines.zh: 如果她真的在做这件事,而不是 Chinami 只是……夸张地误会了什么的话。

lines.en: : Hey, Tsubasa...By any chance, are you free right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿,Tsubasa……请问,你现在有空吗?

lines.en: : Hmm...That’s a difficult question to answer as the freedom I typically have is almost always inhibited by the constant possibility that I may need to stop what I’m doing to address some sort of conflict or trade.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这是个难答的问题,因为我通常拥有的自由,几乎总被一种持续的可能性压制——我随时可能需要停下手中之事,去处理某种冲突或交易。

lines.en: : But I suppose I can find the time to fit you in should you need something from me. And I assume that you do as you wouldn’t call otherwise.
lines.zh: : 不过,若你有事相求,我想我能挤出时间安排你。而既然你打来了,我猜你确实有事。

lines.en: : So I can’t call you just to hang out?
lines.zh: : 所以我不能只是找你玩?

lines.en: : Of course you can. I’d just likely refuse since your time is better spent with my daughters instead of me.
lines.zh: : 当然可以。只是我多半会拒绝——毕竟你的时间,花在我女儿们身上比花在我身上更值。

lines.en: : Yeah, so that’s kind of why I want to talk to you. It’s about them.
lines.zh: : 是,这也算我想找你谈的原因之一。正是关于她们。

lines.en: : Oh my. Touka isn’t pregnant, is she? Because I simply just don’t have the time to deal with that right now.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。Touka 没怀孕吧?因为我眼下实在没时间处理那种事。

lines.en: : If she is, it’s a miracle as I’ve yet to even lay a finger on her.
lines.zh: : 她要是怀了,那才是奇迹,毕竟我连她一根手指都没碰过。

lines.en: : I’m both delighted and offended at the same time. How odd.
lines.zh: : 我同时又高兴又被冒犯。真奇怪。

lines.en: : Tsubasa, it’s your other daughter I want to talk to you about.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa,我想谈的是你另一个女儿。

lines.en: : Oh dear. You got that one pregnant instead? That sounds quite painful for both of you, but welcome to the family regardless.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。你把那个搞怀孕了?听起来你们俩都会相当痛苦,但无论如何,欢迎入伙。

lines.en: : Again, haven’t laid a finger on her. I just...heard something recently that-
lines.zh: : 再说一遍,我一根手指都没碰她。我只是……最近听说了件事——

lines.en: : Let me guess — Tsukasa mentioned something about an arranged marriage to Chinami, who subsequently relayed the message to you out of fear for her friend’s well-being.
lines.zh: : 让我猜猜——Tsukasa 对 Chinami 提了政治联姻之类的事,Chinami 随后出于对朋友安危的担忧,把话转告给了你。

lines.en: : And now you’re upset because it means someone else is going to get to her before you do. Is that correct?
lines.zh: : 而你现在心烦,是因为这意味着别人会抢在你之前得到她。说得对吗?

lines.en: : No. That’s not correct. I’m just worried about how Tsukasa feels in regard to this.
lines.zh: : 不。说得不对。我只是担心 Tsukasa 对这件事是什么感受。

lines.en: : With all due respect, Akira — Tsukasa is not your daughter to worry about. Perhaps that energy would be best spent on Ami instead?
lines.zh: : 恕我直言,Akira——Tsukasa 不是你该操心的女儿。那份精力,或许花在 Ami 身上更合适?

lines.en: : Ami...hasn’t come home in a while.
lines.zh: : Ami……有一阵子没回家了。

lines.en: : Ahh, then I take it this is parenting withdrawal? Tsukasa’s home now if you would like to come over and pamper her. I’m sure she’d be delighted.
lines.zh: : 啊,那我看这是教养戒断反应?Tsukasa 现在在家,你若想来宠宠她,请便。我确信她会欣喜若狂。

lines.en: : Can I just come talk to you instead? This is difficult over the phone since I can’t fall back on how much bigger I am than you when you make me feel weak and powerless.
lines.zh: : 我能不能直接过去找你谈?电话里太难了——你把我弄得又弱又无力时,我连「我块头比你大」这张底牌都没法打。

lines.en: : Is this flirting again? What should I say back?
lines.zh: : 这又在调情了吗?我该怎么回?

lines.en: : Just tell me I can come over.
lines.zh: : 你就说「过来吧」。

lines.en: : You can come wherever you like, Akira. It makes no difference to me.
lines.zh: : 你想来哪就来哪,Akira。对我来说没有区别。

lines.en: : Uhh...cool. Then I guess I’m-
lines.zh: : 呃……好。那我就——

lines.en: : Master Arakawa — right this way, please.
lines.zh: : Arakawa 大师——这边请。

lines.en: : Oh, excellent! That was even quicker than normal. Do tell Daigo I said hello.
lines.zh: : 哦,太好了!比平时还快。替我向 Daigo 问好。

lines.en: : You sent a-
lines.zh: : 你派了——

lines.en: : See you soon, Akira. Oh — and I have a surprise waiting. Ciao!
lines.zh: : 回头见,Akira。哦——我还备了一份惊喜。Ciao!

lines.en: : Tsuba-
lines.zh: : Tsuba——

lines.en: : Master Arakawa-
lines.zh: : Arakawa 大师——

lines.en: : Tsubasa says hello.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa 向您问好。

lines.en: scene black
I hop in the back of the limo and prepare myself for what is already shaping up to be another eventful talk with Tsubasa. And one that comes with a “surprise” at that.
lines.zh: 我跳进豪华轿车后座,做好准备——这眼看又是一场与 Tsubasa 的多事长谈。而且还附赠一份「惊喜」。

lines.en: I just hope that whatever this surprise is doesn’t end up with me chained to a wall or forced into indentured servitude.
lines.zh: 我只希望,这份惊喜别以我被锁在墙上或被迫签卖身契收场。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice1
But I...suddenly realize that isn’t what she was referring to at all.
lines.zh: 但我……忽然意识到,她指的根本不是那个。

lines.en: : So quick again! Daigo’s rapidly becoming my favorite driver out of all of them. I might have to give him a raise at this rate.
lines.zh: : 又这么快!Daigo 正迅速成为所有司机里我最偏爱的一位。照这个速度,我可能得给他加薪了。

lines.en: : Anyway — you already know Yuki, yes? What do you think of her hair? Isn’t this much better than that ugly, faded blonde?
lines.zh: : 总之——你已经认识 Yuki 了吧?你觉得她的头发怎么样?是不是比那头丑陋的褪色金发好多了?

lines.en: : Her hair is the last thing I’m concerned about. I haven’t seen her since-
lines.zh: : 她的头发是我最不关心的事。自从——

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice2
: Since I nearly fuckin’ died in front of you, yeah. What the hell is he doing here? You didn’t tell me he was coming.
lines.zh: : 自从我在你面前差点他妈死掉,对。他到底来干什么?你没跟我说他要来。

lines.en: : It was a surprise for both of you! Now, you no longer have to mope around all upset that you haven’t seen him in so long.
lines.zh: : 这是给你们两个人的惊喜!这样你就不用再为这么久没见到他而垂头丧气、闷闷不乐了。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice3
: What?! I never-
lines.zh: : 什么?!我从没——

lines.en: : She simply won’t stop talking about you. It’s actually made me quite jealous!
lines.zh: : 她简直停不下谈论你。这实际上让我相当嫉妒!

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice4
: That’s a lie! I haven’t-
lines.zh: : 你撒谎!我没有——

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice5
: Wha-?! Dude! The fuck are you doing?!
lines.zh: : 什——?!哥!你他妈在干什么?!

lines.en: : Just let it happen. I’m glad to see you’re okay.
lines.zh: : 顺其自然就好。见你没事,我很高兴。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice6
: Even after I...was a huge fuckin’ asshole to you? And tried to take your money and shit? Why? Thought that bridge was as good as torched.
lines.zh: : 哪怕我……对你混蛋到家了?还试图抢你的钱什么的?为什么?我以为那座桥早他妈烧断了。

lines.en: : You also asked me to come over and fuck you, so it’s not like it was all evil.
lines.zh: : 你还叫我来上你呢,所以也不全是恶。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice7
: I...don’t remember doin’ that. But yeah, still alive. Just...here now.
lines.zh: : 我……不记得干过那个。不过对,还活着。就是……现在在这儿。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice8
: And it’s all thanks to Nee-sama that I-
lines.zh: : 而这全都多亏 Nee-sama,我——

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice9
: N...Nee-sama?
lines.zh: : N……Nee-sama?

lines.en: : Hmph! You’ve never hugged me like that...
lines.zh: : 哼!你可从来没那样抱过我……

lines.en: : I ain’t even doin’ all the huggin’! He just grabbed me outta nowhere!
lines.zh: : 抱人又不是我主动的!他莫名其妙就把我抱住了!

lines.en: : Nee-sama? Wait, you two aren’t-
lines.zh: : Nee-sama?等等,你们俩不是——

lines.en: : We ain’t actually related, no. I’ve just always called her that.
lines.zh: : 我们其实没有血缘,没有。我一直这么叫她而已。

lines.en: : So are you, like...her bodyguard now? Or...
lines.zh: : 那你现在算是……她的保镖?还是……

lines.en: : I think I’m more like a pet than anything at this point.
lines.zh: : 我觉得到了这一步,我更像一只宠物,别的都算不上。

lines.en: : Bad dog! Heel!
lines.zh: : 坏狗!跟上!

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice10
: See what I mean?
lines.zh: : 看到我的意思了吧?

lines.en: : Yeah, but...I can ask more about that later. Are you doing okay? How long do you-
lines.zh: : 是,不过……那些回头再问。你还好吗?你多久——

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice11
: Yuki’s health is no immediate concern and the Tsukioka Foundation is fully covering any and all treatment she may need. It’s the least I can do.
lines.zh: : Yuki 的健康眼下并无大碍,而 Tsukioka 财团将全额承担她所需的一切治疗。这是我至少能做的。

lines.en: : Callin’ it the “least” you can do when you’re savin’ my life is the fuckin’ understatement of the century. I’d be dying without you, Nee-sama.
lines.zh: : 救了我的命还管这叫「至少能做的」,这他妈是本世纪最保守的说法。没有你,Nee-sama,我早死了。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice12
: In that case! May I be hugged next?
lines.zh: : 那样的话!下一个能轮到我被抱吗?

lines.en: : Sure. Go get her, Akira.
lines.zh: : 当然。去吧,Akira。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice13
: Tch! Why is it that I can have everything in life besides the one thing I want?
lines.zh: : 啧!为什么我人生中什么都能拥有,唯独得不到我想要的那一样?

lines.en: : This is...an interesting side of you, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 这是……你有趣的一面啊,Tsubasa。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice14
: Is it? How so?
lines.zh: : 是吗?怎么讲?

lines.en: : You just seem more...relaxed, I guess? There’s no guard up when you talk to Yuki like there is when you talk to me.
lines.zh: : 你看起来更……放松,我猜?你和 Yuki 说话时没有防备,和我说话时却有一套。

lines.en: : Nonsense. Why on earth would I have my guard up around you, Akira? You’re among the least intimidating men I’ve ever encountered.
lines.zh: : 胡说。我在你身边为什么要设防,Akira?你是我见过最不吓人的男人之一。

lines.en: : She just likes fuckin’ with me. Kinda like a big sister pickin’ on the little sister sorta thing.
lines.zh: : 她就是喜欢耍我。有点像姐姐捉弄妹妹那种感觉。

lines.en: : So Tsubasa’s the older sister in this relationship?
lines.zh: : 所以在这段关系里,Tsubasa 是姐姐?

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice15
: Well, yeah. She’s older than me.
lines.zh: : 嗯,对。她比我大。

lines.en: : Wait, so how old is-
lines.zh: : 等等,那你到底多大——

lines.en: : Yuki — didn’t you have some matters to attend to tonight? I practically had to beg just to have you wait around for the surprise.
lines.zh: : Yuki——你今晚不是有事要办吗?为了让你留下来等这个惊喜,我几乎都求过你了。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice16
: Oh, shit! You’re right. I totally forgot.
lines.zh: : 哦,糟!对哦。我彻底忘了。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice17
: I’m goin’ back to the bar to talk to Sara and shit. Ain’t sure if she’ll give me my job back, but I at least want to apologize for bein’ an asshole to her after she went out of her way for me.
lines.zh: : 我要回酒吧找 Sara 什么的聊聊。不知道她会不会把工作还我,但她为我费尽心力,我起码得为当初对她那么混蛋道个歉。

lines.en: : Plus, she doesn’t even know about the cancer thing yet and...yeah.
lines.zh: : 再说,她甚至还不晓得癌症那件事,而且……嗯。

lines.en: : But anyway — I’m gonna be here for a little while. And...I’m sorry to you too. I’m just...you know...kind of a terrible person. So shit like that might happen sometimes.
lines.zh: : 但总之——我会在这儿待一阵。还有……我对你也抱歉。我就是……你知道的……一种烂人。所以那种事有时候难免会发生。

lines.en: : As an equally terrible person, I understand.
lines.zh: : 身为一个同等恶劣的人,我理解。

lines.en: : It was nice seeing you, Yuki. I’m glad you’re okay.
lines.zh: : 见到你真好,Yuki。很高兴你没事。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice18
: Yeah! Uhh...
: Bye.
scene tsubasayukioffice19
Yuki leaves the room and...wait, why am I here again?
lines.zh: Yuki 离开了房间,然后……等等,我为什么又来了?

lines.en: : So —you wanted to talk to me about Tsukasa?
lines.zh: : 那么——你想和我谈 Tsukasa 的事?

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice20
: Oh, right. You’re not, like...actually considering marrying her off to some random guy, are you?
lines.zh: : 哦,对。你不是,那个……真的在考虑把她嫁给某个随机的人吧?

lines.en: : He’d be no random guy, Akira. None of her potential suitors fit that pairing of words. They’re valuable assets from upstanding families who, more than likely, would treat her well.
lines.zh: : 他绝不是什么随机的人,Akira。她的候选追求者里,没一个配得上这组词。他们都是名门望族的贵重资产,多半会待她很好。

lines.en: : She’s a kid...
lines.zh: : 她还是个孩子……

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice21
: Which is probably one more reason why she has so many suitors. Men in power really seem to jump at that sort of thing, don’t they?
lines.zh: : 而这大概也是她追求者众多的又一个原因。掌权男人们对那种事,似乎总是趋之若鹜,不是吗?

lines.en: : And you’re just going to endorse it? You don’t care at all about what this would mean for her as a person?
lines.zh: : 而你就打算背书?你完全不在乎这对她这个人而言意味着什么?

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice22
: What would it mean for her as a person, Akira? Because, from what I understand, you haven’t talked to Tsukasa about this at all. Just one of her friends.
lines.zh: : 对她这个人而言意味着什么,Akira?因为据我所知,你压根没和 Tsukasa 谈过这件事。只找了她一个朋友。

lines.en: : But that friend knows her well and can tell that she’s scared.
lines.zh: : 可那个朋友很了解她,看得出来她害怕。

lines.en: : You’re scared right now and no harm has befallen you yet. Who’s to say the same won’t happen to Tsukasa as well?
lines.zh: : 你现在也很怕,却还没有什么灾祸降临。谁能保证同样的事不会也发生在 Tsukasa 身上?

lines.en: : You want this then? To just...offload her on someone else?
lines.zh: : 所以你想要这个?就……把她卸给别人?

lines.en: : Not at all. As I said — there are valuable assets all over this city willing to merge into the Tsukioka Foundation for the right price. And there will always be things money can’t buy.
lines.zh: : 完全不是。正如我所说——这座城市里到处都是愿意以合适价格并入 Tsukioka 财团的贵重资产。而永远会有钱买不到的东西。

lines.en: : So you intend to just buy them with your daughter’s hand in marriage?
lines.zh: : 所以你打算用你女儿的婚事把他们买下来?

lines.en: : I don’t. My husband does. And this company is even more his child than the girls are. I imagine Touka would be in the same boat if she were not the heir apparent.
lines.zh: : 我不想。我丈夫想。而这家公司甚至比女儿们更像他的孩子。我猜,若 Touka 不是内定继承人,她也会在同一条船上。

lines.en: : What I’m doing is mediating the facilitation of his desires as that is my role in both the company and this family.
lines.zh: : 我所做的,是居中促成他欲望的实现——因为无论在公司还是这个家族,这都是我的角色。

lines.en: : But isn’t it your role as a mother to make sure your children are happy and safe?
lines.zh: : 可作为母亲,确保孩子幸福又安全,不才是你的角色吗?

lines.en: : Indeed it is. Which is why I’d not hesitate to call this off should Tsukasa verbalize her hesitancy. Even mere unease would do the trick.
lines.zh: : 确实是。正因为如此,只要 Tsukasa 亲口说出她的迟疑,我会毫不犹豫地叫停这一切。哪怕只是一丝不安,也足够。

lines.en: : It’s...that simple? Really? You don’t have anything else up your sleeve?
lines.zh: : 就……这么简单?真的?你袖子里没藏别的招?

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice23
: I always have something up my sleeve, Akira. You have to in this line of work.
lines.zh: : 我袖子里永远藏着东西,Akira。干这一行,你必须如此。

lines.en: : Tomonori may be the family head, but do you really think I’m the type to gleefully allow someone else to pull my strings?
lines.zh: : Tomonori 或许是家主,但你真觉得我是那种乐呵呵让他人牵线的人吗?

lines.en: : When you say shit about “facilitating his desires” then yeah, I’m sort of forced to think that.
lines.zh: : 你满嘴「促成他的欲望」这种话,那我多少是被逼着这么想的。

lines.en: : I say what I need to say to protect the things I love. But sometimes, it’s the opposite.
lines.zh: : 为了保护我爱之物,该说的话我照说不误。但有时候,恰恰相反。

lines.en: : Sometimes, the things I don’t say are the ones that ring the loudest...or make the biggest differences. Which is why I’m sure you’ll understand what I’m doing in time.
lines.zh: : 有时候,我没说出口的话才响得最震耳……或造成最大的改变。所以我确信,假以时日你会理解我正在做的事。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice24
: But for now — I imagine I must look pretty evil, don’t I?
lines.zh: : 但眼下——我猜我看上去一定相当邪恶,对吧?

lines.en: : You’d look a lot worse if I didn’t find out five minutes ago that you saved my friend’s life.
lines.zh: : 要不是五分钟前我得知你救了我朋友的命,你看上去会糟得多。

lines.en: : I’ve done no such thing. It takes far more than just money to defeat cancer.
lines.zh: : 我没做过那种事。战胜癌症需要的远不止钱。

lines.en: : I’m just giving Yuki the tools she needs to fight the battle. But she’s the one who will ultimately need to save her own life.
lines.zh: : 我只是给了 Yuki 打这场仗所需的工具。但最终要救她自己命的,是她自己。

lines.en: : You’re helping her either way.
lines.zh: : 无论如何,你都在帮她。

lines.en: : As I’ve said — I protect the things I love. So why do you imagine that what I’m doing with Tsukasa is any different?
lines.zh: : 正如我所说——我保护我爱之物。那你为什么觉得,我对 Tsukasa 做的会有什么不同?

lines.en: : It’s just...a confusing situation for me to hear from one of Tsukasa’s friends that she’s so scared of such a mature thing at her age.
lines.zh: : 只是……从 Tsukasa 的朋友口中听到,她在这样的年纪对如此成熟的事如此害怕,让我很困惑。

lines.en: : Confusing because you feel bad for her? Or because you’re attracted to her?
lines.zh: : 困惑是因为你为她难过?还是因为你被她吸引了?

lines.en: : I’m not-
lines.zh: : 我没有——

lines.en: : I saw what you did in her room, Akira.
lines.zh: : 我看见了你在她房间里做的事,Akira。

lines.en: if christmastsubasa1 == True:
: And almost right after I told you to never cum for anyone other than a Tsukioka in my house again.
lines.zh: : 而且几乎就在我叮嘱过你,在我家里永远不许为 Tsukioka 家以外的人去了之后。

lines.en: : It’s like you disobeyed me on purpose. The audacity.
lines.zh: : 你就像故意违抗我一样。好大的胆子。

lines.en: : Though, I suppose you may have found a loophole. And I suppose that you may have been cumming for Tsukasa despite being so...deep inside of your subordinate.
lines.zh: : 不过,我想你也许钻了个空子。我想,你也许是在为 Tsukasa 而去——尽管你人在你下属的……最深处。

lines.en: : You’ve been a very, very bad boy.
lines.zh: : 你可是个非常、非常坏的男孩。

lines.en: : That was...not a good night for me.
lines.zh: : 那一晚……对我来说不太妙。

lines.en: : Oh, I’m not looking for an excuse. You’re not in any trouble.
lines.zh: : 哦,我不是来找借口的。你没有任何麻烦。

lines.en: : As far as I’m concerned, what you did in there was no different from a live demonstration of the same brand of sexual intercourse she’d see if she looked it up online.
lines.zh: : 在我看来,你在那里做的事,和她上网一搜就能看到的同款性行为的现场示范,没有任何区别。

lines.en: : Which she’s been doing quite frequently as of late. The poor girl doesn’t realize I can see her browsing history right from my telephone. Isn’t technology so fascinating now?
lines.zh: : 而最近她搜得相当频繁。可怜的女孩不知道,我用手机就能看到她的浏览记录。如今的科技是不是很迷人?

lines.en: : I’m not...attracted to her, though. That was just a mistake I made in the heat of the moment.
lines.zh: : 不过我并没有……被她吸引。那只是我在情急之热中犯下的错误。

lines.en: : Bullshit. You know I have eyes everywhere and you knew you’d be caught. You dragged that woman to Tsukasa’s room for one reason and one reason only. You wanted to plant a seed.
lines.zh: : 胡扯。你知道我的眼睛遍布各处,也知道你会被抓包。你把那个女人拖到 Tsukasa 房间,理由只有一个。你想种下一颗种子。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice25
: And no — I’m not talking about the type you planted in her. I’m talking about the type that wakes a curious little girl up.
lines.zh: : 而不——我说的不是你种在她体内的那种。我说的是能唤醒一个好奇小女孩的那种。

lines.en: : And in that regard — bravo, Akira. You’ve done it. But what will you do next? What’s the next phase of your plan? Because you need to hurry now, don’t you? The clock is ticking.
lines.zh: : 而在这一点上——精彩,Akira。你做到了。可接下来呢?你计划的下一阶段是什么?因为你得抓紧了,不是吗?时钟在滴答作响。

lines.en: : If you don’t act quickly, you might never get another chance to fuck some woman in front of my youngest daughter. And that’s far more boring for me too, so I’m rooting for you.
lines.zh: : 你若不快点行动,也许就再也没有机会在我最小的女儿面前上某个女人了。而那对我来说也无聊得多,所以我给你加油。

lines.en: : You’re...rooting for me.
lines.zh: : 你在……给我加油。

lines.en: : I kind of have to. I don’t have much of a choice when all is said and done.
lines.zh: : 我多少不得不。说到底,我没多少选择。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice26
: I wouldn’t be too worried if I were you, though. Even if the video does get out, the audio is barely audible and the footage is rather grainy.
lines.zh: : 不过我要是你就不太担心。就算那段视频真流出去了,音频也几乎听不清,画质还相当模糊。

lines.en: : You...have it on video?
lines.zh: : 你……有视频?

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice27
: Either that or I’m lying. Which one is it, do you think?
lines.zh: : 要么就是我在撒谎。你觉得是哪个?

lines.en: : Tsubasa...what do you want from me? Just tell me instead of trying to blackmail me all the time.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa……你到底想从我这里要什么?直接告诉我,别再总想着勒索我。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice28
: Well, where’s the fun in that?
lines.zh: : 嗯,那还有什么乐趣?

lines.en: : There isn’t any. There doesn’t have to be. Because this might be fun for you, but it’s terrible for me. And the fact that I’m being constantly pushed into making the worst possible decisions is-
lines.zh: : 没有乐趣。也不必有。因为这对你是乐趣,对我却是灾难。而我不断被逼着做出最坏的决定这个事实,已经——

lines.en: : Blah, blah, blah. Sometimes you have to force someone to do certain things or blah, blah, blah. I can’t remember how it goes.
lines.zh: : 等等等等。有时候你必须逼某个人去做某些事,等等等等。我记不清原话了。

lines.en: : Can’t...remember how what goes?
lines.zh: : 记不清……什么原话?

lines.en: : The thing. I’m sure you’ve heard it before, no?
lines.zh: : 那个道理。你肯定听过,不是吗?

lines.en: : I...don’t really know. But either way, I can’t just...do that to Tsukasa if that’s what you’re trying to push me to do.
lines.zh: : 我……不太清楚。但无论如何,如果你是想推我去做那件事,我不能……那样对 Tsukasa。

lines.en: : Because I’m sure it sounds weird, but...I kind of care about her. And I don’t want to hurt her like that because I’ve seen what it turns other girls into.
lines.zh: : 因为我知道这听起来很怪,但……我多少在乎她。我不想那样伤害她——因为我见过那种事会把别的女孩变成什么样。

lines.en: : Do what? I’m oblivious and stupid. I don’t know what you’re alluding to.
lines.zh: : 做什么?我无知又愚蠢。我不知道你在暗示什么。

lines.en: : You know exactly what I’m alluding to. And if you somehow honestly don’t, all you need to do is look up Tsukasa’s search history again for a reminder.
lines.zh: : 你清楚我在暗示什么。要是你真的不知道,只需再翻翻 Tsukasa 的搜索记录,就能想起来。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice29
: Hah! Now, now, Akira — we need to give her some privacy, don’t we?
lines.zh: : 哈!好了好了,Akira——我们得给她留点隐私,不是吗?

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice30
: But we also need to make sure she’s not too ill-prepared for her pending and potentially very scary future...assuming nothing gets in the way of that.
lines.zh: : 但我们也要确保,面对那悬而未决、可能非常可怕的未来,她不会毫无准备……假设没有东西从中作梗的话。

lines.en: : So I’m proposing that you add a new subject to whatever sort of...curriculum you’re using for her tutoring.
lines.zh: : 所以我提议,在你为她辅导所用的一切……课程里,加一门新科目。

lines.en: : And I’m sure you know what that subject is as it won’t be the first time you’ve tutored a girl her age in it. Do you understand what I mean?
lines.zh: : 而我确信你知道那门科目是什么——毕竟辅导你这个年纪的女孩学它,你也不是第一次了。明白我的意思吗?

lines.en: : I...know what you mean. I just don’t know how you know.
lines.zh: : 我……明白你的意思。我只是不知道你是怎么知道的。

lines.en: : You don’t need to. Just play your part and I’ll play mine.
lines.zh: : 你不需要知道。演好你的部分,我演好我的。

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice31
: One thing to note, though — us Tsukiokas are “hands-on” learners. Do with that information what you will.
lines.zh: : 不过有一点要提醒——我们 Tsukioka 家的人,是「动手」型学习者。这条信息,如何使用随你。

lines.en: : What are you reaching for-
lines.zh: : 你伸手要拿什么——

lines.en: : Tsukasa? Can you come to my office for a moment, dear?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa?能来一下我的书房吗,亲爱的?

lines.en: : Tsubasa...what are you-
lines.zh: : Tsubasa……你要干什么——

lines.en: scene tsubasayukioffice32
: You don’t have any plans tonight, do you? I figure I should be here for at least the first session if Tsukasa is going to learn sexual education from a man as unpredictable as you.
lines.zh: : 你今晚没有别的安排,对吧?既然 Tsukasa 要从一个像你这样不可预测的男人那里学习性教育,我想第一堂课我至少该在场。

lines.en: : Now? Seriously? I haven’t even agreed yet. This isn’t-
lines.zh: : 现在?认真的?我连同意都还没同意。这不是——

lines.en: : Oh, Akira. You don’t have a choice! And neither do I — so let’s just make the most of this, shall we?
lines.zh: : 哦,Akira。你没得选!我也没有——所以我们不妨把这一切过到极致,如何?
